comparison.objective: Bimanually squeeze-lifts a handle-less box and places it upright on a riser; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-object bilateral force closure and transport differ from precision asymmetric tool use, controlled impact, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Box must stand upright centered on the riser; candidate requires four tang fractures, four tray deposits, intact hardware, and a stable final state.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; the grasping and placement task lacks notch fracture, retained-part protection, and fragment containment.
